DESCRIPTION:
Next.js server process must be running as PID 1.

        The standalone image runs `node server.js` directly; the kernel
        names the process "next-server (v..." in /proc/1/comm. We check
        for "next" to be robust across minor version changes.
NAME: test_nextjs_server_process_running[docker://arthurs-blog-test]

DESCRIPTION: Standalone build output must be present.
NAME: test_next_build_output_exists[docker://arthurs-blog-test]

DESCRIPTION:
GET /api/recipes/prerequisites has no handler — only POST (admin).
        Verify the route exists but GET returns 405, not 404.
NAME: test_prerequisites_get_is_not_defined

DESCRIPTION: DELETE /api/items/[id] returns 404 for an unknown UUID.
NAME: test_delete_nonexistent_item_returns_404

DESCRIPTION: Container's main process should be alive.
NAME: test_process_has_uptime[docker://arthurs-blog-test]

DESCRIPTION: Verify the app responds to HTTP requests (indicates no crash).
NAME: test_no_crash_in_recent_output[docker://arthurs-blog-test]

DESCRIPTION: Queries shorter than SEARCH_MIN_QUERY_LENGTH return empty results without error.
NAME: test_short_query_returns_empty

DESCRIPTION:
No unexpected privileged port (< 1024) should be listening.

        Next.js internally binds ephemeral high ports for IPC — those are
        allowed. Only flag well-known port range (< 1024) surprises.
NAME: test_no_unexpected_privileged_ports_listening[docker://arthurs-blog-test]

DESCRIPTION:
Next.js must listen on port 3000 inside the container.

        Uses /proc/net/tcp and /proc/net/tcp6 because ss/netstat are not
        present in the minimal node-alpine image.
NAME: test_app_port_listening_inside_container[docker://arthurs-blog-test]

DESCRIPTION:
POST /api/blog/reindex has no auth check — it is intentionally open.
        Verify it returns 200 and a JSON summary (not a 4xx/5xx).
NAME: test_reindex_accepts_post

DESCRIPTION: Secrets should not appear in the process command line.
NAME: test_no_sensitive_env_in_process_list[docker://arthurs-blog-test]

DESCRIPTION: PID 1 must not run as root — verified via /proc/1/status.
NAME: test_process_runs_as_non_root[docker://arthurs-blog-test]

DESCRIPTION: Write and delete a probe file using node (touch is not in alpine).
NAME: test_cache_directory_writable[docker://arthurs-blog-test]

NAME: test_nextjs_user_exists[docker://arthurs-blog-test]
